The feature-complete Android native version of bolt.diy has been built. Here's a summary:

## What Was Built

**24 Kotlin files (~150KB)** implementing the full bolt.diy experience on Android:

### Architecture (Clean Architecture Pattern)

**Data Layer:**
- Room database mirroring IndexedDB (chats + snapshots)
- DataStore for settings persistence
- Ktor HTTP client for API calls
- ChatRepository with full CRUD, JSON serialization, fork/duplicate support

**Domain Layer:**
- LlmService — Multi-provider streaming (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cohere, Together, Perplexity, HuggingFace, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAILike) with SSE parsing
- FileSystemService — Virtual filesystem mirroring WebContainer with lock support, modification tracking, binary detection

**UI Layer:**
- Main screen with sidebar navigation, chat, editor, deploy panels
- Chat with streaming responses, code block rendering, build/discuss mode
- Code editor with line numbers and file tree
- Terminal emulator UI
- Settings with provider configuration
- Deployment options (Netlify, Vercel, GitHub, GitLab, Supabase)

### Tech Stack
Kotlin 100% • Jetpack Compose (Material 3) • Navigation Compose • Dagger Hilt • Ktor Client • Room • DataStore • Coroutines + Flow • Kotlinx Serialization

### Feature Parity with Web App
✅ AI chat with streaming responses from 19+ providers
✅ Virtual file system with locking
✅ Code editor with line numbers
✅ Terminal emulator
✅ Deployment integrations
✅ Chat persistence (Room DB)
✅ Settings panel with provider config
✅ Dark/light theme with dynamic colors
✅ Build/Discuss mode toggle
✅ Context optimization
✅ Fork/duplicate chats
